name: Janaihou Jigoku
source:
"I'll never be anyone's first."

On a late and rainy summer night, your 18-year-old niece came by uninvited.

She seems to have her reasons...

Her future is up to you!

[Translated from [url=https://www.porontesuta.com/zyanazigo]official website[/url]]
translation:
“我永远不会成为任何人的第一。”

在一个夏末的雨夜，你18岁的侄女不请自来。

她似乎有她的理由……

她的未来就看你了！

[翻译自[url=https://www.porontesuta.com/zyanazigo]官网[/url]]
